name: Miss Fisher and the Deathly Maze
source:
Become Phryne Fisher, the independent, feminist super-sleuth. Players will guide the heroine on a modish dance of adventure, murderous mayhem and mystery around the world.

Armed with her golden gun and with her companion, Dot Williams, in tow, the pair chase the trail of the insidious Murdoch Foyle. Foyle has escaped the gallows once again, with Phryne on his trail. Can Miss Fisher and Dot decipher his clues and stay on his trail? Or will they be tricked into pursuing a false lead, causing the trail to run cold?

[From [url=http://gamebookadventures.com/gamebooks/miss-fisher-and-the-deathly-maze/]official website[/url]]

Episode 3 was cancelled due to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/711430/discussions/0/1694917906654173386/]lack of sales[/url].
If the overall series arc storyline will not reach a conclusion, the first two episodes were written to be stand-alone, each one featuring a single murder mystery, and therefore should be able to be appreciated for themselves.
translation:
成为Phryne Fisher，一位独立的女权主义超级侦探。玩家将引导女主角在世界各地踏上充满冒险、凶残混乱和神秘的时尚舞蹈。

两人手持金枪，在同伴多特·威廉姆斯的牵引下，追寻阴险的默多克·福伊尔的踪迹。弗雷再次逃离了绞刑架，芙里妮紧随其后。费舍尔小姐和多特能破译他的线索并追踪他吗？或者他们会被欺骗去寻找错误的线索，导致线索消失吗？

[来自[url=http://gamebookadventures.com/gamebooks/miss-fisher-and-the-deathly-maze/]官方网站[/url]]

由于[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/711430/discussions/0/1694917906654173386/]销量不足[/url]，第3集被取消。
如果整个系列的故事情节无法得出结论，那么前两集是独立编写的，每一集都有一个谋杀之谜，因此应该能够被欣赏。
